data.name: Inaayat
data.gender_notes: Inaayat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Inaayat is derived from the Arabic root ‘n’w’t meaning to give or to bestow. It is a name of Allah meaning Grace, Favor, and Blessing. In Islamic tradition, Inaayat refers to the blessings and favors that Allah bestows upon His creation. The name Inaayat carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Inaayat usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Inaayat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Inaayat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
